newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Uniwide rises in midtrade on bargain-hunting.
newsitem.headline: Uniwide rises in midtrade on bargain-hunting.

text.p: Mall and real estate developer Uniwide Holdings Inc climbed 30 centavos, or 5.76 percent, to 5.5 pesos in midsession on bargain hunting, brokers said.
"Some people are reviving stocks which have been battered in recent weeks," Noel Reyes, research head of Anscor Hagedorn Securities, said.
Uniwide was one of the mostly heavily traded stocks in an otherwise sluggish market.
Uniwide was one of the stocks which was hit hard by fears of an impending property crash. It hit its year-low of 4.80 pesos on May 20.
